Description: Ladin Classification benchmark explores NLP in extremely low-resource settings, focusing on Ladin, an endangered Romance language (Val Badia variant). The study creates synthetic datasets for sentiment analysis and multiple-choice question answering by translating monolingual Italian data, applying rigorous filtering and back-translation procedures. The benchmark evaluates LLaMA 3.1, GPT-4o, MBART, NLLB, m-DistilBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, and mT5 models, demonstrating how synthetic datasets can improve machine translation baselines and establish foundational resources for underrepresented languages.
